read.thesis: Q1 CY26 adj. EBITDA $983M vs $644M as Middle East supply shock tightened nitrogen; but Yazoo City outage cuts 2026 ammonia output to 9.5Mt with no restart before late Q4, and 2026 capex held near $950M for CF.

utilisation.quote: which represents utilization of 99% of available gross ammonia capacity.

capex.quote: management projects capital expenditures for full year 2026 will be approximately $1.3 billion

triggers.label: Utilisation 99% of available ammonia capacity
triggers.quote: which represents utilization of 99% of available gross ammonia capacity.

triggers.label: Middle East 50-60% capacity curtailed in March
triggers.quote: The Company estimates that 50-60% of ammonia and urea capacity in the Middle East was curtailed or offline in March due to the conflict with Iran.

triggers.label: Average selling prices higher across all segments
triggers.quote: Average selling prices were higher for all segments in the first quarter of 2026 compared to the first quarter of 2025

triggers.label: Yazoo City outage; no restart before late Q4
triggers.quote: Management does not expect production to resume at the Yazoo City Complex until late fourth quarter of 2026 at the earliest

triggers.label: North America channel inventory at average levels
triggers.quote: Management believes nitrogen channel inventory in North America is at average levels

guidance.quote: The Company expects gross ammonia production for the full year 2026 to be approximately 9.5 million tons
For the full year, management projects capital expenditures for CF Industries, excluding the portion of capital expenditures funded by JERA and Mitsui, to be approximately $950 million.
potentially reaching 10-12 million metric tons for the year
Management believes that China will begin limited exports of nitrogen products later in the second quarter of 2026.

red_flags.label: Litigation gain flatters Q1 earnings
red_flags.quote: First quarter 2026 financial results reflect a gain of approximately $170 million from a litigation settlement
